meta.title: WENRO — Local experiences in Hurghada
meta.description: Discover and book trips and local experiences in Hurghada.

home.title: Find your next experience.
home.subtitle: Sea, desert and culture around Hurghada — clear prices, easy booking.
home.heroTitle: Experiences worth the trip, around the Red Sea.
home.heroSubtitle: Reefs, dunes, temples and quiet evenings — clear prices, free cancellation windows and pay on the day.
home.searchLabel: What would you like to do?
home.topPicksSub: One standout trip from every category.
home.why1Text: Reserve your seat now and pay the operator in cash at the start — no card needed.
home.why2Text: Every trip shows how long you can cancel for free, before you book.
home.why3Text: Trips are run by licensed operators based in Hurghada.
home.why4Text: Add a transfer from your hotel in the same booking.
home.partnerTitle: Run trips, or send guests our way?
home.partnerText: Operators, agencies, hotel desks and creators manage bookings and earnings in one dashboard.

finance.title: Money
finance.sub: Cash is collected by operators at the trip. WENRO collects its share monthly and pays partners.
finance.step1: Guests pay the operator in cash at the trip.
finance.step2: Monthly: create statements of what each operator owes.
finance.step3: When an operator pays, mark it received.
finance.step4: Then prepare partner payouts and send them via InstaPay.
finance.unsettledTitle: Trips done, not on a statement
finance.tripsDue: {n, plural, one {# trip} other {# trips}}, owes
finance.generateHint: Includes every checked-in trip in the period that is not on a statement yet. Running it again only adds trips checked in since.
finance.createPayoutsHint: Groups every payable commission into this month's payout ({month}); if that was already paid, into next month's.
finance.legalNote: Amounts are in the collection currency. Record the exchange rate you used when paying in EGP. Invoices, tax and withholding rules need review by an Egyptian accountant before launch.

partner.title: Your partner page
partner.subMarketer: Share your link. You earn 10% of every trip that runs.
partner.subAgency: Book for your clients or share your link. You earn 10% of every trip that runs.
partner.noCode: Your code appears once WENRO approves your account.
partner.linkHint: Anyone who books within 30 days after opening your link counts for you (the last link opened wins; a typed code beats a link).
partner.rules: No commission on cancelled, no-show or weather-cancelled trips, or when you book for your own phone number.
partner.qrHint: Print or show this code; it opens the same link.
partner.stagesHint: Earnings move to 'ready' once the operator has settled with WENRO. Payouts go out monthly, no minimum.
partner.clicksHint: Counted on experience pages. No personal data is stored.

messages.sub: Every email the platform sends, newest first.
messages.modeLog: Development mode: no email provider is set, so messages are written to the server log and marked “Logged”, not sent. Add RESEND_API_KEY and MAIL_FROM in the hosting settings to send for real.
messages.modeLive: Live: emails are sent through the email provider.
